description: This section of our 1000+ C# multiple choice questions focuses on destructors in class in C# Programming Language.

questions.question: Which operator among the following signifies the destructor operator?
The method called by clients of a class to explicitly release any resources like network, connection, open files etc. When the object is no longer required?
questions.explanation: Dispose() is only method called by clients of a class to explicitly release any resource like network connection, open files etc. When object is no longer required. Hence, Dispose() provides programmer with such programming control.

questions.question: Operator used to free the memory when memory is allocated?
questions.explanation: 'New' is used to allocate memory in the constructors. Hence, we should use 'delete' to free that memory.
